proposal.activation: Debug-only and opt-in from platform_app_qa via a new explicit --soop-vod-click-probe argument. It sets one process-local diagnostic flag before run_with_context; default QA, ordinary Atsumi and release builds remain unchanged. Native eligibility additionally requires debug_assertions, the exact generated local.atsumi.platformqa.<32lowercasehex> identity, the explicit flag, and public VOD209244227. No persisted setting, IPC activation command or account/profile copying.
proposal.placementDecision: platform_app_qa delegates to run_with_context, which owns the full production Builder/setup and exposes no narrow child-view hook. Adding a generic app/plugin callback just for this probe would broaden scope. Use a source-local debug initialization selector in original_vod.rs instead. Keep original_vod_page.js bytes unchanged: for eligible QA only, insert one independent observer block immediately before the unique document pointerdown registration inside its existing IIFE, where epoch/fullscreen are already available. Validate exactly one known insertion anchor; if it changes, use the unmodified script and no probe rather than altering or failing playback. This is initialization-only, not attachment to an arbitrary running browser or CDP.
proposal.observation: Register passive capture pointerdown and click observers before the existing adapter listener, so the latter's stopImmediatePropagation cannot hide a successfully delivered event. For at most16observed events, classify target with fixed selectors only: chat if inside #chatting_area; excluded for the existing editable/menu exclusions or outside #player; fullscreen_button if inside #player and closest original fullscreen selector; otherwise player_other. Project only event kind pointerdown|click, category, isTrusted boolean, button===0 boolean, epoch>0 boolean and fullscreen===true boolean. Do not inspect tag/class strings beyond these fixed closest checks, text, values, activeElement, bounding boxes, styles, coordinates, key events, URLs or DOM serialization. Use no preventDefault, stopPropagation, focus, pointer capture, synthetic event, resize, timer or media action. Remove both observers at the16event cap or pagehide; original handlers remain untouched.
proposal.transport: Use a separate debug-only prefix and strict fixed schema, not a new normal fullscreen kind or privileged IPC. The observer sends only the six projected enum/boolean fields, never epoch value, id, title, nonce or URL. Existing exact top-level official embed guard still encloses it. Native receives only on this already-owned SOOP VOD controller, validates exact current official source and label before accepting diagnostic rows, rejects oversized input and unknown/extra fields, and never passes diagnostic data to an input receipt, coordinator or status updater. Page-supplied trusted flags are observations, not native authority.
proposal.bridgeAcceptance: In the same debug-only eligible path, observe an otherwise parsed normal fullscreen mouse envelope at the existing acceptance point. Evaluate the unchanged accepts predicate once, use that exact result for existing control flow, and project only kind=bridge plus sourceAccepted,epochAccepted,accepted booleans. sourceAccepted means existing exact label and official-document policy; epochAccepted means positive equality to the current epoch; accepted includes all unchanged existing checks. Do not copy IDs, source text, epoch numbers, enabled payloads, arbitrary errors or unknown messages into output. Keep status and all keyboard messages unobserved. This does not relax any rejected envelope.
proposal.outputAndBound: A SOOP-local per-bridge atomic budget caps DOM and bridge observations together at16rows for that controller lifetime. The page also sends at most16DOM rows. Output only a fixed console prefix and native-reconstructed typed JSON to the isolated example's already captured stdout, not the production diagnostic recorder, feedback service, network or a new user-data file. No new shared diagnostics.rs fields are needed. Do not log unique receiver/session correlation IDs or timestamps; one public VOD is tested at a time and ordering is sufficient. Budget exhaustion is not interpreted as absent input. Invalid/oversized/unknown diagnostic input is discarded without logging raw content or affecting normal messages.
proposal.testScope: Add focused pure schema/budget/source-eligibility/anchor tests and an exact-adapter VM test proving the observational rows precede the unchanged fullscreen request while original prevent/stop calls occur exactly as before. Exercise normal pointerdown+click, click-only, player-other, chat/editable/outside, false trusted/right button, unconfigured page, native ack/EOF/repeated cycle,16cap and detach. Release/default script must be byte-identical and observer failure must not stop playback or production input.
